name: lines_by_id
note: ProductTemplateAttributeLine (addons/product/models/product_template_attribute_line.py): every line with its template, attribute, sequence, value_count and active flag as the ORM reads them (active_test off)
source_sql: SELECT id, product_tmpl_id, attribute_id, sequence, value_count, active FROM product_template_attribute_line ORDER BY id

name: values_per_line
note: product.template.attribute.line.product_template_value_ids one2many (addons/product/models/product_template_attribute_line.py) read path: embedded product.template.attribute.value per line with the ptav_active count and the lowest product_attribute_value_id; lines without values excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT attribute_line_id, count(*) AS values_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ptav_active) AS active_values, min(product_attribute_value_id) AS first_value FROM product_template_attribute_value GROUP BY attribute_line_id ORDER BY attribute_line_id
